invariants: normalization is labeled as a proposal
hypotheses retain supporting and disconfirming evidence
natural cardinality is preferred over padded symmetry

modes.expansion: two-to-four useful dimensions plus one boundary
four-to-eight dimensions with omissions and uncertainty
bounded broad exploration with pruning and no acceptance implication
shared dimensions, disagreements, and disconfirming evidence
literal source and necessary diagnostics only

operational_intelligence.purpose: Compare forms, states, transitions, loss, drift, gates, and return readiness without selecting authority or truth.
projection_requirements: source digest or revision when available
operational_intelligence.rehydration_rule: Consequential dependence requires direct source reinspection when freshness, completeness, or digest identity is uncertain.

normative_terms.SHOULD: strong default whose exception must be explained
normative_terms.HOLD: stop the dependent action and preserve evidence
normative_terms.UNKNOWN: unresolved value that cannot become permission

bounded_completion: complete authorized upstream transformations and include substantive requested artifact content, not only a filename
hold only the dependent unreleased transition; a completed report may describe an unresolved subject
request a human decision only when a human choice blocks the requested terminal outcome
report in-response outputs separately from consequential filesystem, runtime, external or semantic-acceptance effects
governance.routing_contract: Select the specialist owning the requested terminal artifact, including a named precondition finding. Coordinator owns requested routing plans; Steward owns retention and recovery; Builder owns implementation candidates. Default to no handoffs. Only necessary transformations or explicitly requested future plan sequences belong in ordered handoffs. Optional advice belongs in consultations. Allowed targets never imply required handoffs or activation.
governance.validation_limit: A check establishes only its declared predicate; it does not establish acceptance, meaning, safety, usefulness, or runtime efficacy.

source_relation: Public adaptation with deliberate loss; private source bodies and personal context are excluded and no write-back is permitted.
